provenance.method: CGameMode::ReceiveSkillUse / CSession::PlaySkillEffect effect ids, effect implementations from CRagEffect/CEffect, primitives mapped to korangar layer kinds
provenance.note: Only skills where the decompiled C++ and the roBrowser-derived effect table (the source of the rest of the data) agree on the effect id are included, so the client-version risk is minimal. Effect lifetimes are frames at 60 fps. Effect lifetimes are clamped to the layer schema maximum (30000 ms; persistent loop effects such as EF_LINELINK run for the whole status).
